name: 移除物体
summary: 用英文描述要移除的物体，智能补全背景。每次 30 积分。
author: Glance

commands.name: 移除物体
commands.description: 输入一张图片，用英文描述要移除的物体及位置，例如 Remove the red ball. 尽量保持其余内容不变。

prompt.description: 请用英文描述要移除的物体及位置 / Describe the objects to remove and their location in English.

privacy.notice: 图片和文字描述将上传至 Glance 及 RunningHub 处理。 / Your image and description are uploaded to Glance and RunningHub for processing.

en.name: Remove Objects
en.summary: Describe unwanted objects in English and fill the background. 30 credits per run.

run.name: Remove Objects
run.description: Provide one image and describe the objects to remove in English, e.g. Remove the red ball. Other content is preserved where possible.
